Current role · Thakral Enterprise · Consumer technology

DJI, Plaud, BOOX & Active LED

Marketing Manager at Thakral Enterprise, running go-to-market and marketing for a portfolio of global technology brands

DJI Plaud BOOX

Challenge

Several world-class brands in very different categories (drones and cameras, AI note-takers, e-ink tablets and LED products), each with its own buyer, launch calendar and competition, all managed by one marketing team. Every launch had to land with the right audience and turn interest into sales.

Strategy

Position each brand for the buyer who gets the most value from it: creators and professionals for DJI, busy business professionals for Plaud, readers, students and note-takers for BOOX, and businesses for Active LED. Then run every launch on one repeatable playbook, so the team could move fast without losing quality.

Execution

  • Product launch campaigns from announcement to sales push
  • Social media content and short-form product videos
  • Product pages, SEO and online listings
  • Trade-show marketing, including the DJI Ronin 4D showcase at ABIS 2026 (Asia’s Broadcasting & Infotainment Show)
  • Demos, events and partner activations
  • Close coordination with sales and channel partners, plus performance reporting

Results

A consistent launch process across four brands, stronger brand visibility in each category, and a steady flow of qualified enquiries handed to the sales team.

Canada · Financial services · 6 months

Akal Mortgages

Driving high-intent leads for a specialist mortgage broker

Read the case study Visit live site

Challenge

Strong niche services in construction financing and private lending, but low online visibility, generic ads, tired creatives and slow replies to new enquiries, so good leads were going to competitors.

Strategy

Stop marketing “mortgages” and reposition everything around the two specialities. Then build one system that attracts, qualifies and responds to leads automatically.

Execution

  • Niche-targeted ad campaigns with ongoing creative and copy testing
  • A new mobile-friendly landing page built to capture leads
  • A regular social media content calendar to build trust
  • An instant-response receptionist flow so no enquiry waits
  • HubSpot CRM workflows for email and SMS follow-up and booking

Results

Higher lead quality, faster response times, more booked consultations, and ad performance that stayed strong over time instead of fading.

New York City · Education · Since 1994

Khan’s Tutorial

Keeping NYC’s long-running test-prep brand in front of parents who search before they choose

Visit live site

Challenge

A trusted 8-location brand in a crowded test-prep market, where parents compare options online before booking anything. The brand needed to stay visible for exam searches and turn that attention into free consultations and trial classes.

Strategy

Search-first growth: own the searches parents make for each exam (SHSAT, SAT, Regents, state exams), answer their real questions with helpful content, and guide every visit toward one clear next step, a free trial class.

Execution

  • On-page SEO across program pages (see SEO samples)
  • Blogs and resources written for parents
  • Off-page SEO and link building
  • Social media posts and videos
  • Promotion of free trials, workshops and scholarships

Results

Stronger visibility for exam-related searches and a steady stream of parent enquiries for consultations and trial classes.

Global · Aerospace, defense & industrial · NYSE-listed

Curtiss-Wright

Making a complex engineering brand easier for technical buyers to find

Visit live site

Challenge

Hundreds of highly technical products across many divisions, sold to engineers and procurement teams who search for precise terms. Content had to be accurate, consistent and easy to find.

Strategy

Match the website and content to how technical buyers actually search, and keep brand messaging consistent across divisions so every page builds the same trusted reputation.

Execution

  • Keyword research around technical buyer searches
  • On-page SEO and content optimisation
  • Off-page SEO and quality link building

Results

Improved organic visibility for key product and capability searches, supporting a global enterprise brand’s digital presence.

North America · Agency & SaaS · HubSpot Gold Partner

webdew

Growing an agency brand that serves clients across the US and Canada

Visit live site

Challenge

An agency competing for international clients needs to prove its expertise everywhere buyers look, while delivering on many client accounts at once.

Strategy

Lead with expertise: useful content, strong search visibility and video that show what the agency can do, backed by smooth client delivery.

Execution

  • Brand events
  • Client coordination across North American accounts and support for sales

Results

Multiple client campaigns delivered across education, finance and B2B, and hands-on experience running marketing for international clients end to end.

I’m Sushmita, a Marketing Manager with over 4 years of experience. Today I’m Marketing Manager at Thakral Enterprise, managing marketing for global technology brands including DJI, Plaud, BOOX and Active LED. Before that I worked at webdew, a HubSpot Gold Solutions Partner agency serving clients across North America.

My work sits where strategy meets execution. I define how a brand should be positioned, plan how it goes to market, then run the channels that make it happen: SEO, content, video, social media, link building, events and paid campaigns. I also manage client relationships end to end and work closely with sales teams.

Based in Bengaluru, India, and available for calls during US mornings and UK and Europe afternoons.
